rows.comment: This is Sorrentino's best film so far
rows.verdict_le10: This is Sorrentino's best film so far
rows.dek_lead: This is Sorrentino's best film so far, a movie with all the angular caricature and cosmopolitan suavity that marked films such as Il Divo, The Family Friend and The Consequences of Love, but with a new operatic passion

rows.title: 'The Great Beauty' Review: Paolo Sorrentino's Magnificent Tribute to Rome
rows.comment: the city whose magnificence has famously entrapped its residents in existential crises
rows.verdict_le10: the city whose magnificence has famously entrapped its residents in existential crises
rows.dek_lead: Rome in all its splendor and superficiality, artifice and significance, becomes an enormous banquet too rich to digest in one sitting in Paolo Sorrentino’s densely packed, often astonishing “The Great Beauty.” A tribute to, and castigation
